stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

import os,glob,re,json,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(I,check=True):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r_ in I for x in r_)
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda x:cnt[x])
    box=None
    for v in sorted({x for r_ in I for x in r_}):
        p4=[(r_,c_) for r_ in range(H) for c_ in range(W) if I[r_][c_]==v]
        rs={a[0] for a in p4}; cs={a[1] for a in p4}
        if len(p4)==4 and len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2:
            br0=min(rs);br1=max(rs);cl0=min(cs);cl1=max(cs);mk=v;box=(br0,br1,cl0,cl1);break
    res=[row[:] for row in I[br0:br1+1]]
    ic=[(r_,c_) for r_ in range(br0,br1+1) for c_ in range(cl0,cl1+1) if I[r_][c_] not in (bg,mk)]
    inner=[]
    for c_ in comps(ic):
        # keep only cells with interior color != frame marker? comps includes marker border touches. exclude marker cells from comp: take non-bg non-mk cells of this component
        sub=[a for a in c if I[a[0]][a[1]] not in (bg,mk)]
        inner.append(sub)
    assert len(inner)==1,'inner comps:'+str(inner)
    tmpl=inner[0]
    ih=max(a[0] for a in tmpl)-min(a[0] for a in tmpl)+1
    iw=max(a[1] for a in tmpl)-min(a[1] for a in tmpl)+1
    sr=min(a[0] for a in tmpl)-br0; sc=min(a[1] for a in tmpl)-cl0
    ocells=[(r_,c_) for r_ in range(H) for c_ in range(W) if I[r_][c_] not in (bg,mk) and not(br0<=r_<=br1 and cl0<=c_<=cl1)]
    outcols=sorted(set(I[a[0]][a[1]] for a in ocells))
    R=res[-(ih+1):]; C=res[-iw:]
    # find free slot inside template region in cropped grid (relative to crop coords)
    fr=[[cell==I[a[0]][a[1]] and cell!=mk for a in tmpl for cell in [] ]] 
    target_row=sr+iw-1; target_col=sc+iw-1  # bottom-right occupied cell position relative to box
    newcells=[(sr+a[0]-tmpl[0][0]+target_row+1 - (target_row+1) + a[0], 0) for a in [(0,0)]]
    return res, tmpl, (sr,sc,iw,ih), outcols
print(solve(G['Demo pair 2 input']))

        rs={r for r,_ in ps}; cs={c for _,c in ps}
        if len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2: mk=col; break

    def comp_cells(seed):

    sol=[]

                vr=min(r for r,_ in [x for xx,vv in [] for x,vv in [(0,0)])]  # placeholder

            for i in range(fh):

            mism=[]
            for t in tmpl:

                i,j=slotmap[colv]
                wantR,Rwant=R+i*bh,C+j*bw
                wantC_ = C+(t[0][1]-t[0][0])*? if False else None
                # template may be larger than one slot: require template bbox within slot window

import collections
def comps_of(I,bg):
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    for r_ in range(h):
        for c_ in range(w):
            if I[r_][c_]!=bg and (r_,c_) not in seen:
                st=[(r_,c_)]; seen.add((r_,c_)); cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and (na,nb) not in seen and I[na][nb]==I[a][b]:
                            seen.add((na,nb)); st.append((na,nb))
                comps.append(cells)
    return comps
for i in [1,2,3,5]:
    D=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for row in D for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find marker color: color appearing exactly 4 times
    mk=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==4][0]
    mpos=[(r,c) for r in range(len(D)) for c in range(len(D[0])) if D[r][c]==mk]
    rs_=sorted({p[0] for p in mpos}); cs_=sorted({p[1] for p in mpos})
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs_),max(rs_),min(cs_),max(cs_)
    crop=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in D[r0:r1+1]]
    B=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    print('pair',i,'crop==out?',crop==B)
    # diff cells
    diff=[(r_,c_,crop[r_][c_],B[r_][c_]) for r_ in range(len(B)) for c_ in range(len(B[0])) if crop[r_][c_]!=B[r_][c_]]
    print('  ndiff',len(diff),'sample',diff[:10])

import collections,os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps_of(I,bg):
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    for r_ in range(h):
        for c_ in range(w):
            if I[r_][c_]!=bg and (r_,c_) not in seen:
                st=[(r_,c_)]; seen.add((r_,c_)); cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and (na,nb) not in seen and I[na][nb]==I[a][b]:
                            seen.add((na,nb)); st.append((na,nb))
                comps.append(cells)
    return comps
def solve(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for row in I for x in row)
    # marker color = the one with exactly 4 occurrences forming rectangle corners; exclude corner-colored 0s? use the one whose 4 cells form a rectangle bbox with no other same-color cells inside bbox besides it.
    box=None; mark=None
    for col,n in cnt.items():
        if n!=4: continue
        pp=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r][c]==col]
        srs=sorted({p[0] for p in pp}); scc=sorted({p[1] for p in pp})
        if srs[1]-srs[0]>=2 and scc[1]-scc[0]>=2 and set(pp)=={(srs[0],scc[0]),(srs[0],scc[1]),(srs[1],scc[0]),(srs[1],scc[1])}:
            box=(srs[0],srs[1],scc[0],scc[1]); mark=col; break
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs0,rs1,c0,c1=box
    ins_comps=[set(t) for t in comps_of(I,bg) if all(rs0<r<rs1 and c0<c<c1 for r,c in t)]
    outs_comps=[set(t) for t in comps_of(I,bg) if not all(rs0<=r<=rs1 and c0<=c<=c1 for r,c in t)]
    O=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in I[rs0:rs1+1]]
    th=tw=None
    tmpl=ins_comps[0]
    th=max(p[0] for p in tmpl)-min(p[0] for p in tmpl)+1
    tw=max(p[1] for p in tmpl)-min(p[1] for p in tmpl)+1
    # outside fragments: order them by their absolute position within the full grid? use stack order hypothesis: sort by (min row of fragment rel to crop? ) We'll compute later per demo.
    R=[]
    for o in outs_comps:
        co=I[min(p[0] for p in o)][min(p[1] for p in o)]
        fr=min(p[0] for p in o)-rs0
        fc=min(p[1] for p in o)-c0
        R.append((co,fr,fc))
    return O,R,tuple(ins_comps),th,tw,(rs0,rs1,c0,c1)
for i in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    O,R,tmpl,th,tw,box=solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])
    B=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    print(i,'shape',th,tw,'frag count',len(R),'out shape',len(B),len(B[0]))
